column4: cleat#2223: guards on CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL, which ci.yml's test-go/plugins job sets nowhere (that job's env is CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_CRASH_DB only, postgres service, no mysql or mssql service) -- so it skips once in this job while PostgreSQL-backed tests run. MySQL-only by nature, not by omission: the test re-applies webhookingest's v3/v4/v7 UpMySQL text twice to assert idempotency on ALTER TABLE/CREATE INDEX statements that have no PostgreSQL or SQL Server counterpart (those dialects' migrations use IF NOT EXISTS-style DDL already). Measured by NAME on this job's own run (job 110224335966, PR #2881): exactly one skip event for this test, with CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL unset and CLEAT_TEST_DB pointing at the job's postgres service.
